scope: Constructed controls and finite-depth decision checks, not independent-game accuracy or winning-position certificates.

timeline.label: Forcing Mate
timeline.evidence: Rg7+ starts a forced mating attack. Every legal defence permits mate within 4 moves; one verified line is Rg7+ Kh1 Qh3+ Qh2 Qxf1+ Qg1 Qxg1#. The exact continuation depends on the defence.

timeline.label: Deflection
timeline.evidence: Qh3+ forces the queen on f2 away from defending the rook on f1. After Qh2, Qxf1+ wins material. Before that displacement the same guard could legally recapture on f1; every legal check evasion now concedes a verified gain. The deflection happens with this check, not with an earlier quiet move.

timeline.label: Checkmate
timeline.evidence: Qxg1# is checkmate: the king is in check and there is no legal reply.
